name: 沭阳县中医院 · 上海中路28号院区
method: Visually compared labelled street/aerial photographs with existing source footprints projected from WGS84 into GCJ-02 AMap satellite tiles. Photo perspective and roof displacement are not ground survey measurements.

excludedSources.name: 中医大厦
excludedSources.reason: Separate northern L-shaped source; not the photographed ward tower. No height or facade changes in this batch.

evidence.observed: Pale cyan glazed west podium, stone entry surround, dark portal, hospital name, green bus shelter; tower has horizontal window bands and a white vertical sign strip.
Hospital-labelled tower, U-shaped west podium, courtyard, east wing and curved river end; URL year is not a verified image date.
Shanghai Middle Road 28; description mentions a 19-storey ward building and separately a Zhongyi tower. This is not a measured height or a dated as-built survey.

evidence.reason: Architectural CGI; excluded as evidence of built facade.

estimates: Tower display body 68.4 m = 19 storeys x 3.6 m; roof about 71 m. Neither is surveyed. The original 25.9 m raster height remains intact in the source data.
Window/piers, roof curvature, entry surround, roof equipment, shelter bays, paving dimensions and placements are approximate.
The dark entry panel is exterior-only; no new traversable doorway, campus route, or source collider cut is introduced.
Medical grades, cooperating-hospital names, old pharmacy tenants, bus routes and advertising visible in undated photos are omitted.
North/east tower elevations, campus rear walls, current curb furniture, true doorway position and measured heights remain unverified.
distribution: Source URLs and review metadata only; no third-party photographs or satellite tiles are bundled into the static release.
